entries.title: Proverbs 2:1
segments: ¶My son, if you will take my words to your heart, storing up my laws in your mind;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:2
segments: So that your ear gives attention to wisdom, and your heart is turned to knowledge;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:3
segments: Truly, if you are crying out for good sense, and your request is for knowledge;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:4
segments: If you are looking for her as for silver, and searching for her as for stored-up wealth;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:5
segments: Then the fear of the Lord will be clear to you, and knowledge of God will be yours.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:6
segments: For the Lord gives wisdom; out of his mouth come knowledge and reason:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:7
segments: He has salvation stored up for the upright, he is a breastplate to those in whom there is no evil;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:8
segments: He keeps watch on the ways which are right, and takes care of those who have the fear of him.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:9
segments: Then you will have knowledge of righteousness and right acting, and upright behaviour, even of every good way.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:10
segments: ¶For wisdom will come into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasing to your soul;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:11
segments: Wise purposes will be watching over you, and knowledge will keep you;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:12
segments: Giving you salvation from the evil man, from those whose words are false;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:13
segments: Who give up the way of righteousness, to go by dark roads;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:14
segments: Who take pleasure in wrongdoing, and have joy in the evil designs of the sinner;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:15
segments: Whose ways are not straight, and whose footsteps are turned to evil:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:16
segments: To take you out of the power of the strange woman, who says smooth words with her tongue;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:17
segments: Who is false to the husband of her early years, and does not keep the agreement of her God in mind:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:18
segments: For her house is on the way down to death; her footsteps go down to the shades:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:19
segments: Those who go to her do not come back again; their feet do not keep in the ways of life:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:20
segments: So that you may go in the way of good men, and keep in the footsteps of the upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:21
segments: For the upright will be living in the land, and the good will have it for their heritage.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:22
segments: But sinners will be cut off from the land, and those whose acts are false will be uprooted.
